Working Student Software Engineer

Acme Logistics GmbH
Berlin, Germany · 1 week ago · Over 100 applicants
Promoted by hirer · Actively reviewing applicants
  • On-site

About the job

About the role

Acme Logistics builds route-planning software for mid-sized European retailers. As a working student in our platform team you will help us ship features that make deliveries faster and greener.

What you will do

  • Build and test REST endpoints for our route optimisation service
  • Improve the reliability of our data pipelines
  • Review code and pair with senior engineers

What we offer

Flexible hours around your lectures, a mentor from day one and occasional remote work when the team agrees on it.

Requirements

  • Currently enrolled in a Computer Science or related degree at a German university
  • Solid experience with Python and SQL
  • Fluent English; German is a plus
  • Available for 15 to 20 hours per week
